title: Logistics & freight → Floras on transport spend
floras_mechanism: For logistics providers, carriers, freight forwarders, and shippers with significant transport spend, Floras embeds climate-designated value into qualifying freight or logistics transactions. For 3PLs and carriers (supplier role), Floras differentiates service contracts and links invoices to verified projects. For shippers (buyer role), Floras accumulates in an enterprise wallet from transport procurement — addressing Scope 3 Category 4 (upstream transportation) with transaction-linked funding and certificates.
pain_signals: transportation is a major Scope 3 emissions source
freight spend is disconnected from climate funding
shipper needs evidence linking transport procurement to mitigation
carrier or 3PL faces RFP pressure on transport emissions
difficulty funding verified projects proportional to freight activity
budget_source: Logistics and freight budget; transport procurement budget; ESG or Scope 3 program budget; carrier sales enablement budget
safe_claims: Floras can link climate-designated value to freight or logistics transactions
Shippers can connect transport procurement activity to verified project allocation
Logistics suppliers can differentiate contracts with transaction-linked climate value
Certificates can support Scope 3 transportation reporting narratives when research supports them
conditional_claims: If the lead is a 3PL or carrier, pitch supplier-side embed to win shipper accounts
If the lead is a shipper with high freight spend, pitch wallet accumulation from transport procurement
If the company reports Category 4 emissions, Floras can complement disclosure with funded mitigation evidence
avoid_claims: Freight or shipping becomes carbon-neutral by default
Every shipment automatically offsets a specific CO₂ percentage
Floras replaces fleet electrification or mode-shift strategies

output_templates.one_liner: Turn {company_name}'s freight and logistics spend into verified climate action — not generic offsets.
output_templates.short_pitch: {company_name} manages meaningful logistics or freight activity where transportation drives Scope 3 pressure. Floras embeds climate-designated value into qualifying transport transactions — whether you are a shipper building wallet value from freight procurement or a 3PL/carrier differentiating enterprise contracts. Allocated Floras flow to verified projects with certificates that connect transport spend to funded climate impact for reporting and customer narratives.

objections_and_responses.objection: We already buy logistics offsets or SAF separately.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras links funding to freight and logistics transactions themselves, giving visibility into which transport spend generated value and what projects were supported — rather than treating transport mitigation as a disconnected annual purchase.

objections_and_responses.objection: Transport emissions are hard to reduce — we mostly optimize routes.
objections_and_responses.response: Route optimization and mode shift remain primary levers. Floras complements them by building transaction-linked climate value from ongoing freight activity, with documentation that supports Scope 3 transportation narratives.

objections_and_responses.objection: Are you pitching us as a carrier or as a shipper?
objections_and_responses.response: Entity type determines the angle: shippers accumulate wallet value from transport procurement; carriers and 3PLs embed Floras to differentiate enterprise contracts. The mechanism is the same — transaction-linked value — but the commercial story follows your role in the value chain.
